text: Owner’s Manual An owner's manual is an essential resource for anyone who owns the 'Simple Ultra' providing comprehensive information and instructions for operating, maintaining, and troubleshooting it. By reading and following the instructions in this manual, you can ensure a safe and enjoyable experience while using the scooter, while also extending the life of the vehicle and minimizing the need for repairs. Failure to read and follow the instructions in this manual could result in serious injury, damage to the vehicle, or voiding of the warranty. Therefore, it is strongly recommended that you take the time to read and understand this manual fully before operating the scooter. simpleenergy.in 04

text: General Safety and Warnings Following are the safety measures and warnings which makes your ride safe and secure. Ensure to refer and adhere to the safety information before using the vehicle. 3.1 User Safety List of safety instructions that the user should follow, failing which can result in serious injury or death to the user and serious damage to the vehicle. - Make sure to do several laps in a safe place to get familiar with the vehicle. - Always wear a helmet and ensure that you use a helmet that is at least ISI certified. - Always plug in or plug out the power cords only when the power is switched 'OFF’. - In the absence of adult supervision, keep the charging port away from children. - Incorrect or misused connections to the battery charger may damage the equipment or put the user in a hazardous condition. - Make sure that you and the pillion rider are properly seated before starting the ride. - Do not use a mobile phone while driving, as it may disturb your attention. simpleenergy.in 17

text: General Safety and Warnings 3.4. Thermal Runaway If a thermal runaway occurs, the entire screen turns red with white warning messaging, accompanied by a warning buzzer audio alarm on the Instrument Cluster Assembly. - During such events stop the scooter at safe location and step away from the scooter to a safe distance. - Do not try to intervene with the scooter to stop the smoke or fire. - Do not use any sort of liquids (water) to stop the fire as it may lead to the risk of explosion. simpleenergy.in 20

title: simple_ultra_owners_manual
text: 9.2. Charging My Battery 9.2.1. Charging your scooter The Charger can be used to recharge the vehicle’s battery conveniently and safely. When the Charger connector is connected to the vehicle inlet, a communication link is established between the Charger and the vehicle. The charge cycle is initiated automatically and is dependent on the demand of the vehicle. The vehicle controls the charging rate during the charge cycle, and the Charger will stop supplying power to the vehicle when the battery is fully charged, as indicated by the vehicle. If necessary, you can stop the charge cycle by disconnecting the power supply to the Charger. If the Charger remains connected to the vehicle, you can resume an interrupted charge cycle by switching the power supply back ON. title: simple_ultra_owners_manual
text: Maintenance Schedule Proper and regular maintenance is crucial for the optimal performance of the 'Simple Ultra'. The following section outlines Simpleenergy's recommended schedule for inspecting, checking, replacing, adjusting, lubricating and servicing the vehicle. Neglecting this schedule may cause accelerated wear and severe damage to the vehicle, leading to a reduced lifespan. If the vehicle is exposed to high levels of stress, such as continuous full throttle or driving in a dusty environment, some maintenance tasks may need to be performed more frequently than the recommended schedule. This is necessary to ensure the vehicle's reliability. Key components such as steering, suspension, and wheels require special care and attention. The recommended maintenance schedule is mandatory and should only be carried out by Simpleenergy's authorised team. Regular inspections may reveal the need for replacement of one or more parts. It is highly recommended to replace scooter parts with original Simpleenergy parts for smooth warranty coverage and vehicle durability. Appropriate maintenance is required to ensure that the vehicle is reliable and provides optimal performance at all times. simpleenergy.in 89

title: simple_ultra_owners_manual
text: Maximise Your Ride 12.2. Charging Instructions: - Preparation: • Ensure the vehicle is turned off before connecting the charger. • Inspect the charger, cables, and connectors for any signs of damage or wear. - Connection: • Plug the charger into a suitable 15 Amps socket. • Connect the charging cable to the vehicle’s charging port securely. - Initiate Charging: • Switch on the power supply to the charger. • Monitor the charging indicator on the charger and the vehicle to ensure proper connection and charging. - Monitor Charging: • During the initial charging sessions, stay nearby to monitor the charger’s operation. • Check for any unusual sounds, smells, or overheating. - Completion: • Once charging is complete, switch off the power supply before disconnecting the charger from the vehicle. • Disconnect the charger from the socket and store it in a safe place. simpleenergy.in 100
